sources.summary: A zigzagging red facade and rooftop running track are among the key features of Jihlava Municipal Arena, completed by architecture studio Chybik + Kristof in the Czech Republic. Located in the heart of Jihlava, the 5,650-seat building was designed for a local ice hockey team, but will also serve as a "cultural and civic hub" The post Red facade "evoking a hedgehog" wraps ice hockey arena by Chybik + Kristof appeared first on Dezeen .
